$comment: The global header and footer, on every public page (src/components/GlobalHeader.astro, GlobalFooter.astro, through src/layouts/Site.astro). Tasks in the main nav, audiences in the utility links and the footer, one button (Join The Labs), as design/information-architecture (the project doc) sets out. An href starting with / is a page here; anything else is a key into home.json's links (the live site). Workshops, Build Cycles and Find a Lab have their pages; About goes to the live site until its page is built (a later PR).

footer.lede: Free workshops and team projects at your local public library, made by volunteers and open to anyone.

footer.google: You join by signing in with Google. We use only your name, email address and profile picture, and never ask for your Gmail, Drive or Calendar.
